text:
deploy-bot: start rollout release-3.2.0 -> canary (12%) in us-west1 at 7190000001. watch p95, error-rate, kv-cache. autopilot mode=notify_only (no auto-revert).
emma: seeing embeds p95 jump on canary hosts at ~7190000006. baseline ~70ms -> now ~210ms. dash: https://internal.metrics/redwood/3.2.0/embeds
rachel: can you paste the host-level query?
emma: `topk(5, avg_over_time(embeds_p95_ms[2m])) by (host)`) shows same 3 hosts affected.
devrel: is rollback safe for embeddings-only? we rely on same binary across routes sometimes.
emma: we can do route-level traffic-slice: route=embeddings. option A: set canary=0 and pin to 3.1.4. Option B: pause rollout and keep current canary while investigating.
tim-oncall: autopilot disabled -> manual decision. given customer impact, prefer targeted pin + customer note.
rachel: +1 targeted pin. run `redwoodctl rollout traffic-set --route=embeddings --canary=0 --target=3.1.4` then pin: `redwoodctl versions pin --route=embeddings --version=3.1.4 --reason "p95 spike on 3.2.0 canary"`
emma: executing traffic-set now.
deply-bot: (simulated) traffic_set complete 7190000010 -> embeddings canary=0%.
emma: pin applied 7190000011. `redwoodctl versions pin` returned success.
support-bot: created ticket RED-7702 "embeds latency on 3.2.0 canary" and pinged #support-team at 7190000012.
devrel: drafting release-note blurb: "Targeted rollback: embeddings route pinned to 3.1.4 due to transient latency increase on canary 3.2.0. Investigating KV-cache and kernel path. No data loss expected."
tim-oncall: legal cc'd for high-tier accounts. please notify account teams.
emma: account teams notified 7190000014. metrics back to baseline on pinned slice.
rachel: who's owning RCA? emma for customer timeline, infra (alex) for kv-cache traces.
emma: I'll take timeline. Alex assigned in RED-7702.
support-bot: customer message queued to impacted accounts at 7190000016.
emma: final status: targeted rollback executed, embeddings pinned to 3.1.4, canary paused for route. follow-up RCA in 48h. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: events recorded: traffic_set=7190000010 pin=7190000011 customer-notify=7190000016.
emma: closing thread and updating release tracker. thanks all.
